governance_mode.description: Checkpoint gatekeeper governance level: strict-4-gate (C0, C1, C2, C3), streamlined-2-gate (C1, C3), or autonomous-batch

max_repair_attempts.description: Maximum Reflexion repair iterations between @Engineer and @Auditor before human checkpoint escalation

toolchain.description: Python verification test discovery and static validation configuration

scratch_retention.description: Lifecycle of .pipeline_scratch/ transient staging: consume-once cleans rollback/OCR staging immediately; archive-trace additionally persists per-agent reasoning traces (*_trace.md) into specs/<slug>/scratch_traces/

max_visual_pages.description: Visual plate warning cap for PDF sources (default 32 based on gemma4:e4b 37% context pre-knee; 0 renders all pages without cap; PDFs exceeding cap stage 32 salience-ranked plates with a warning while SOURCE_TEXT.md preserves all 1..N embedded text pages verbatim)

approved_research_domains.description: Additional workspace-approved domains auto-authorized for web_fetch research alongside approved_sources.json

allow_web_research.description: When false, disables web_fetch so @Researcher extracts equations, constraints, and target_interface strictly from the user prompt, SOURCE_OCR.md, and research/ files (closed-book / benchmark mode)

enable_local_spec_critic.description: Local semantic and executable specification screening mode after manifest.json and mapping.json: 's1_only' (default, 1-pass source-gated Stage 1 executable toy-vector @Auditor audit before Checkpoint 1 seal), 'system1_s1_s2' (<1 s boundary pplx-decider-flash screen with automatic 'off' fallback), 'off' (AST-1..4 + Stage 4 Cleanroom @Auditor only), 's2_only', or 's1_and_s2' (boolean true maps to 's1_and_s2', false maps to 'off')

decision_model.description: Boundary-only System-1 decision model (/v1/systemone, keep_alive=0 under OLLAMA_MAX_LOADED_MODELS=1) for semantic spec screening, Stage 4 rewind triage override, and Method L3 edit line-scope localization

enable_post_archive_embed.description: When true, Stage 5 archival triggers templates/extensions/post_archive_embed.py (or post_archive_embed.py) out-of-band to index archived artifacts via Ollama /api/embed

upstream_seals.description: Optional workspace-relative paths to upstream PROVENANCE.json cryptographic seal files (e.g. specs/<upstream_slug>/PROVENANCE.json) that @Facet and hypervisor-guard must verify before launching @Orchestrator

experiments.description: Configurable runtime policy controls for source ingress, coordinator residency, System-1 trigger gating, Cleanroom context hydration, rewind invalidation, and Stage 4 Cleanroom read confinement

source_ingress_mode.description: Source ingress policy — dual_tier_explicit_promotion (default: research/ stays the sole auto-scanned folder while explicitly user-named workspace files/folders and Chat attachments promote automatically) vs strict_research_aligned (research/-only)

coordinator_residency.description: Coordinator model residency policy across S1->S4

sys1_trigger_policy.description: Boundary System-1 (pplx-decider-flash) invocation trigger policy (default ast_risk_gated skips 3rd-model loads on clean specs)

context_hydration.description: Upstream contract hydration mode injected in subagentStart (default s2_s3_selective_hydration hydrates S2/S3 specs + S4 signature stub only)

rewind_dag_policy.description: Rewind stage-invalidation policy after MAPPING_DEFECT / MANIFEST_DEFECT repairs

contract_and_gates.description: Caller contract framing, C1 assumption gate scope, and idempotent read-loop guard mode

auditor_cleanroom_policy.description: Stage 4 @Auditor Cleanroom implementation-read confinement policy (default two_phase_post_pytest locks pre-pytest reads and unlocks after pytest failure)

engineer_hydration_mode.description: Stage 3 @Engineer lossless specification hydration representation (default unified_build_sheet joins manifest.json and Cleanroom-redacted mapping.json into a single deduplicated build sheet)

engineer_repair_mode.description: Stage 3 @Engineer warm repair code-context policy (default pointer_full_view pairs <workspace_map> AST [Lstart..Lend] symbol spans and <20 KB view_range chunks with full sibling visibility)

engineer_escalation_mode.description: Stage 3 @Engineer output-truncation compaction handoff and MAPPING_DEFECT Stage 2 contract escalation policy

stage_checklist_mode.description: Zero-tool-call deterministic <stage_checklist> injection in subagentStart across @Orchestrator, @Engineer, and Stage 4 @Auditor (default hook_subagent_start; off disables checklist injection)
